mapper.select: select * from member2 order by m_no desc
select m_no, TRIM(m_email) as m_email, TRIM(m_pw) as m_pw, m_name, m_nickname, m_auth, m_verified, m_provider, m_provider_id from member2 where TRIM(m_email) = TRIM(#{userId})
mapper.insert: insert into member2( m_no, m_email, m_pw, m_name, m_nickname, m_gender, m_birth, m_tel, m_addr, m_date, m_auth, m_provider, m_provider_id ) values( 'M'||LPAD(member2_seq.nextval, 5, '0'), #{m_email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_pw, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_nickname, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_birth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_addr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 'ROLE_USER', #{m_provider, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_provider_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: update member2 set m_pw = #{m_pw}, m_name = #{m_name}, m_nickname = #{m_nickname}, m_tel = #{m_tel}, m_addr = #{m_addr} where m_no = #{m_no}
